MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The 4K streaming stick could complement my Raspberry Pi and TV setup by giving me a dedicated way to stream video.",
    "The longer HDMI cable fits my interest in connecting equipment and routing cables neatly, reflected in my HDMI cable, cable covers, and cable ties."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plugs, Echo speakers, and smart displays introduce voice-control uses I have not shown a need for; buying computer accessories does not mean I want an Alexa setup.",
    "The large drives assume a storage upgrade I have not planned. My memory-card purchases served particular devices, rather than showing a need for much more storage.",
    "The HD streaming stick serves the same purpose as the 4K version I already preferred, so I would not choose both."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into interest in almost any connected gadget, even when it solves a different problem.",
    "My Kindle purchase seems to have been taken as interest in other Amazon devices, although reading does not give me a reason to want Alexa products."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Many of my purchases solve concrete setup problems: wired networking, cable management, headphone storage, cleaning, and protecting equipment.",
    "Compatibility and a specific use matter to me. A memory card for a named GPS device or accessories for a Raspberry Pi are more meaningful than a broad resemblance to other electronics."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my TV and computer setup interests but stretched them into unsupported needs for Alexa devices and large storage upgrades."
}
